label: preparing
what: A civic presentation thanking the mayor for public service, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00–18:30, with private contents and likely bread refreshments. The mayor was told of and approved the event, but the secretary explicitly agreed to keep its contents private. Innkeeper organized it; baker and builder coordinated a forty-four-loaf order paid in materials, likely connected though not conclusively linked. Freight carried bread but knowing participation is not established; neither is neighbour involvement.
